text: showcase use, also use PVdagger package draw DAGs, documented following website: https://pvverse.github.io/pv_dagger/. remember pregnancy often acts confounder, modifying chance exposed drug manifesting event. can introduce distortion disproportionality analysis. Two common scenarios can represented way: Pregnancy positive confounder, increasing chance drug event. situation, can see disproportionality lack reaction. Pregnancy negative confounder, example drug partly controindicated pregnancy (e.g., lack evidence safety) event instead common pregnancy. situation, can miss disproportionality presence reaction. two examples, represented using directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). situations need condition variable introducing confounder. words, can restrict pregnancy reports, algorithms can become extremely useful. can use select background disproportionality_analysis function DiAna described .  see case positively confounded disproportionality disappears restricting pregnancy reports.  see case negatively confounded disproportionality appears restricting pregnancy reports.
code: # run only once. pak::pak("PVverse/pv_dagger") library(PVdagger) #> Loading required package: DiagrammeR create_dag("antiD_ig", "nausea",   label_inquiry = "",   confounder_path = list(     nodes = list("Pregnancy"), signs = list("+", "+"),     label = "Confounding by Pregnancy (+)"   ) ) create_dag("nivolumab", "premature_delivery",   label_inquiry = "",   confounder_path = list(     nodes = list("Pregnancy"), signs = list("-", "+"),     label = "Confounding by Pregnancy (-)"   ) ) restrictions <- list(   "Crude" = Demo$primaryid,   "Pregnancy" = matrix_flagged_for_pregnancy[UMC == TRUE]$primaryid )   drug <- "anti-d immunoglobulin" event <- "nausea"  disproportionality_df <- data.table() for (n in seq_along(restrictions)) {   t <- restrictions[n]   t_name <- names(t)   t_pids <- unlist(t)   df <- disproportionality_analysis(     drug_selected = unlist(drug),     reac_selected = unlist(event),     temp_drug = Drug[role_cod %in% c("PS", "SS", "I")],     restriction = t_pids   )[, nested := t_name]   disproportionality_df <- rbindlist(list(disproportionality_df, df), fill = TRUE) } disproportionality_df <- disproportionality_df[, expected := (D * E / (D_E + D_nE + nD_E + nD_nE))]  render_forest_table(disproportionality_df) drug <- "nivolumab" event <- list("preterm birth" = list("premature baby", "premature delivery"))  disproportionality_df <- data.table() for (n in seq_along(restrictions)) {   t <- restrictions[n]   t_name <- names(t)   t_pids <- unlist(t)   df <- disproportionality_analysis(     drug_selected = unlist(drug),     reac_selected = unlist(event),     temp_drug = Drug[role_cod %in% c("PS", "SS", "I")],     restriction = t_pids   )[, nested := t_name]   disproportionality_df <- rbindlist(list(disproportionality_df, df), fill = TRUE) } disproportionality_df <- disproportionality_df[, expected := (D * E / (D_E + D_nE + nD_E + nD_nE))]  render_forest_table(disproportionality_df)
